text:
- **Agent repo feedback:** Agents can now give feedback on the repo with pm feedback add --repo. The separate pm feedback questions command was removed, and its questions now appear in the help for pm feedback add.
- **Project overview page:** The overview now lists open projects first. Closed projects appear in one collapsed section at the bottom.
- **Search evaluation harness:** A checked-in offline eval now reproduces the earlier search results. Work started on the second retrieval model.
- **Cross-repo pull request review:** A pull request in another repo can now be reviewed through gh. The merge watcher now records its merges.
